verification_scope: four post checkpoints and two saved changed-native witnesses independently replayed; all other counts read from frozen runs/existing completed audit; no repeat of 1024 raw full candidates

supported: Both shared raw catalogs completed all256 families and512 canonical full checks per arm with identical selector hashes.
Four real weighted ALNS leaves made 4115 iterations; all pin/shape rollbacks were zero, and independent saved witnesses show ordinary task owner/order changes.
DIRECT polish improved each of its own raw macros, but one best only returned the original input; the other lost weighted score despite lower total lateness.
Neither relay leaf improved its own initial raw macro. Saved changed-native alternatives were feasible, kept all6 real crosses andK25, and scored worse.
Most accepted iterations reconstructed unchanged routes: DIRECT1305/1337; RELAY1327/1346. Counts do not prove that all nonbest candidates were sampled or scored identically.

All four helper absolute time budgets were used; wrapper outer deadline flags and skipped_timeout/rejected_results are zero, returned checkpoints were checked before their deadlines, and all restoration flags are true.

Each arm has100 raw N58 and412 raw N59 candidates. Every N58 saves unpinned native65 only; bestN58 still has all6 selected late and loses weightedJ because L/D rise. They were not selected for the two polish leaves, so the experiment does not measure repairing those N58 macros.
hypotheses_not_proven: Generic destroy/repair often reconstructs the incumbent under exactquota and six fixed plans; richer joint relocation/resequencing may be needed, but no optimality or impossibility follows.

The6 selected modes/roles/station/subsequence remain fixed; freeing194 ordinary tasks does not release those selected structures. No matched ablation isolates which particular pin causes the lack of improvement.
limits: Single predeclared extra-budget checkpoint diagnostic, not a from-scratch same-budget superiority result.
The two arms share raw family selection and policy, but choose their own2 best complete macros; the polished macro identities are not paired.
Only first8 complete repair candidates plus namedbest/checkpoints are saved per leaf; changed-native witnesses do not quantify all attempted owner changes.
N/L subgroup differences are descriptive. Distance is a whole-route quantity with co-load interaction; no invented per-task distance decomposition.
Weighted arithmetic needed to offset a loss is not an attainable improvement bound.
Do not generalize N59 at weighted-best/post checkpoints to all raw candidates: raw has100 N58 per arm; objectiveJ deliberately ranks other physical tradeoffs above these N58 candidates.
